You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many additional students would have joined campus by the end of May beyond the students present at the beginning of the year? The number of students on campus doubles at the end of every month. There are 10 students on campus at the beginning of the year. The question concerns the number of students on campus by the end of May. A doubling means the new population is twice the original population. Percentage increase is calculated relative to the original population. The student population is multiplied by 2 after each completed month.
